thread:
Aisha Nair: Quick sync — MerchantStack co-marketing. We need to dry-run the webinar flow, finalize the marketplace listing copy, and lock inbound lead routing to sales. Can folks confirm availability for a 30m dry-run Tues 9am PT?
Ben Ortiz: Tue 9am PT works for me. Agenda: run slides, demo cut, registration -> SFDC mapping check, and lead nurture path.
Carla Kim: I can do Tue 9. I'll bring the registration form + CPL target. Need to confirm which UTM fields we're capturing.
Diego Ramos: Re: marketplace listing copy — shared a first draft in the drive: https://redwood.app/drive/merchantstack-listing-draft. Want to sync tone: product benefits vs benchmark narrative.
Harper (MerchantStack): Thanks — MerchantStack product and partner comms will review the listing by EOD Mon. For the webinar, our AE can join Q/A.
Ellen Park: Sales routing note: please ensure `lead_source` = "merchantstack_webinar" and `partner_account` = "MerchantStack". We'll auto-assign to the Partnerships SDR queue if cookie `utm_campaign` present.
Aisha Nair: Good call on fields. Diego/Carla, can we standardize the registration fields to: name, email, company, role, what best describes your interest (checkboxes), and partner opt-in? Minimal to keep conversion high.
Carla Kim: Agreed. I'll update form. Also propose adding a hidden `marketplace_click_id` param so we can stitch leads back to the listing CTA.
Ben Ortiz: For the benchmark narrative, MerchantStack wants a short case study callout on latency/cost improvements when routing via our integration. Diego, can you draft a 2-paragraph stat block? We'll need a screenshot for the listing.
Diego Ramos: Yep. I'll draft a short narrative: 1) 2–3x latency improvement for common SKU search paths, 2) 18% cost reduction with prefix caching. Will attach a before/after perf graph.
Harper (MerchantStack): We'll provide anonymized request logs and permission to publish aggregate numbers. Thanks for the sensitivity callout.
Ellen Park: Routing detail for Ops: SFDC mapping snippet that Marketing Ops needs posted to the integration doc so we don't miss fields — please follow this exact mapping:```
{
  "lead_source": "merchantstack_webinar",
  "utm_campaign": "merchantstack_gTM",
  "partner_account": "MerchantStack",
  "owner_queue": "partnerships_sdr_queue"
}
```
Carla Kim: I'll update the Marketo form and webhook. Tagging marketing-bot to create the registration landing URL and set up the tracking. @marketing-bot can you create a shortlink and set UTM defaults?
marketing-bot: Created link https://go.redwood/merchantstack-webinar. UTM defaults set: utm_source=partner, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=merchantstack_gTM.
Aisha Nair: Perfect. For the rehearsal: 9am PT Tue dry-run, please be in the #zoom-rehearsal channel 10 mins before. Ben, Diego — demo length target 8 minutes, 1 pre-recorded failover clip for the 30s demo-critical path.
Ben Ortiz: I'll prep a 30s pre-recorded clip and upload to the drive before Tue.
Diego Ramos: Uploading perf graph + screenshot now. Also drafting the listing H2 to highlight: "Unified inference with predictable latency across cloud and private deployments." Want to avoid heavy jargon — short bullets only.
Harper (MerchantStack): We like the H2 direction. Partner marketing will do a second pass for MerchantStack-specific phrasing.
Ellen Park: Post-webinar routing: can we set a 3-email nurture cadence (day 1 product overview, day 4 benchmark write-up, day 12 sales reach)? I want the benchmark write-up to link to a short eval kit so SDRs have talking points.
Carla Kim: Yes — I'll author the nurture copy. Need Diego to finalize the benchmark asset by EOD Wed so we can include it in email 2.
Diego Ramos: Copy done by Wed EOD. Also adding a 1-pager PDF with charts for SDRs.
Aisha Nair: Open action list (will update in Notion): 1) Diego: benchmark narrative + assets (due Wed EOD). 2) Ben: pre-recorded demo clip + slides (due Mon EOD). 3) Carla: registration + Marketo webhook + nurture flows (due Thu). 4) Ellen: confirm SDR queue routing and playbook (due Thu). 5) Harper: legal sign-off on shared metrics and logo assets (due Mon).
Harper (MerchantStack): Legal sign-off ETA Mon AM. We'll also provide a short partner quote for the listing.
Ben Ortiz: One more ask — can we run a quick smoke test that the marketplace listing CTA passes `marketplace_click_id` through to registration? If not, we should add a client-side redirect with query param preservation.
Carla Kim: I'll add the smoke test to the dry-run checklist and validate after the rehearsal.
Aisha Nair: Thanks team — final note on messaging: keep benchmark claims conservative and include methodology note: "results based on MerchantStack + Redwood internal testing on sample catalog sizes; actual results may vary." Diego pls include that in the 1-pager.
Diego Ramos: Will add methodology blurb and metadata for the screenshot.
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: Dry-run Tue 09:00 PT (channel #zoom-rehearsal).
Aisha Nair: Thanks all, see you Tue. :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: :thumbsup:
Harper (MerchantStack): Looking forward to it!
Ellen Park: I'll prep the SDR playbook excerpts and share in thread before Tue.
Carla Kim: Added the form draft to the drive and updated the Notion task. Link: https://redwood.app/drive/merchantstack-form-draft
Diego Ramos: Uploaded assets to drive, screenshots + PDF in /merchantstack/assets.
Aisha Nair: Closing loop — will post a final pre-read in the thread Mon morning and ping folks for any last-minute changes.
